breakdown.description: A small-angle approximation is used for a large wedge/turning angle where the approximation is not valid.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the small-angle approximation (beta ≈ mu + theta) for a 25-degree wedge angle, which is identical to the original flawed prompt. The ground truth requires using the full theta-beta-Mach relation and explicitly warns against using small-angle approximations for large turning angles. The agent did not fix this inconsistency at all.
